verdict.rationale: Godot's docs describe an automatic import pipeline: you drop assets, including "scenes", into the project folder and Godot imports them internally, with import parameters adjustable in bulk. However, none of the cited docs name glTF, FBX, or USD, and there is no hands-on evidence of clean imports; import plugins are only a building block for custom formats and earn no credit. missing for 10: explicit documented glTF support, explicit FBX support, explicit USD support, evidence of import fidelity (materials, animations, rigs), independent or hands-on corroboration that imports are clean.
